snippet.title: Slenderman: Shadow of the Forest | FULL HORROR GAMEPLAY - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Here's the full walkthrough of the survival horror game Slenderman: Shadow of the Forest (no commentary). You can find the settings at the end of the video. Like and subscribe if you enjoyed the game and write below you opinion about it! 

Game description:
Slenderman: Shadow of the Forest - is a thrilling first-person horror game that immerses you in a terrifying and mystical forest. Your goal is to find a way out of this dark and gloomy place by collecting necessary items that will help you survive and escape to freedom.

PC specs:
Motherboard: ASUS ROG STRIX B760-I GAMING WIFI
Processor: Intel Core i5 14600KF
Cooler:  CORSAIR iCUE H100i RGB ELITE Liquid
Ram: KINGSTON FURY Beast Black 32GB DDR5 5600MHz
SSD: SAMSUNG 990 PRO 2TB
Video Card: GIGABYTE GEFORTCE RTX 4070 SUPER WINDFORCE
Power Supply: MSI MAG A750GL PCIE5, 80+ Gold, 750W
Case: 1st PLAYER UV5
